subject: Urgent: Quarter-end discount governance sprint — action required
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: finance_ops@oriondata.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Quarter-end discount governance sprint — action required

Team —

We have a cluster of Q2 opportunities where discounts > 15% were applied without completed deal-desk sign-off. These are likely to move our committed forecast if not reconciled by EOD tomorrow. Please treat this as a short, focused governance sprint to clean the book and ensure Finance has accurate commits.

Immediate asks:
- Review attached discount_holdlist_q2.csv (columns: deal_id, rep, current_stage, discount_pct, pricing_approver = blank if missing).
- For each row where discount_pct >= 15% and pricing_approver is blank, either: 1) obtain explicit deal-desk approval, or 2) move the opportunity back to "At Risk" stage in HubSpot.
- Update the "Forecast Flag" property in HubSpot (Commit / Best Case / At Risk) after action so Finance can pick it up.
- If you approve a discount, reply with the approval email or attach the signed redline (we'll archive in the Drive folder linked below).

Key cutoffs:
- Any change to Commit that affects ARR should be entered before 12:00pm PT on Monday 26 Apr to be reflected in the Monday forecast sweep.

I'll be coordinating with Finance on the side (cc'd). Karthik — can you triage the high-dollar deals and provide rulings for any that need elevated review? Vanessa/Laura — please run the deal hygiene pass for your respective reps and update HubSpot.

Attached: discount_holdlist_q2.csv (filtered export)
Links: https://drive.redwood.example/drive/folders/1a2b3c-discount-sprint

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Quarter-end discount governance sprint — action required

On Sun, Apr 25, 2027 at 09:12, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We have a cluster of Q2 opportunities where discounts > 15% were applied without completed deal-desk sign-off...

Thanks, Marcus — I pulled the CSV and started the pass. Quick notes so we can prioritize:
- ORN-3421 (AE: Sam R.) — 20% discount, legal redline pending. Rep says customer is in procurement hold; I recommend moving to At Risk until we have pricing sign-off.
- ORN-3578 (AE: Leila M.) — 18% discount, customer has verbally agreed to the term sheet. Karthik: please confirm if you can expedite formal sign-off; otherwise we should treat as Best Case.
- ORN-3665 (AE: Jonah P.) — 25% discount on pilot, low ARR; suggest we keep as Commit but flag for finance review (we need clarity on revenue recognition).

I'll update HubSpot properties as I finish validation for my book and will add notes to each record. If you want, I can consolidate all At Risk moves into one bulk spreadsheet so Finance can ingest easily.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager, East
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, finance_ops@oriondata.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 12:27:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Quarter-end discount governance sprint — action required

Marcus / Vanessa —

Thanks for the triage. I reviewed the top five by ACV and am taking the following immediate actions: 
- ORN-3421: Escalated to Deal Desk. I granted conditional approval (20%) subject to signed amendment. I attached the redline I will accept (orion_pricing_redline.pdf). Please ask the AE to get the counter-signed copy into the Drive and ping me.
- ORN-3578: Not approved at 18% as-is. We can approve 15% if the AE updates the proposal and logs the commercial concessions. Marked this record Best Case for now.
- ORN-3665: Approved to remain Commit (pilot specific, recognized as service credit). Finance team, please confirm treatment for revenue recognition.

Action items for Sales Ops:
- Marcus/Laura: ensure the HubSpot Deal properties reflect the updated approvals and that the approval email or redline PDF is attached to each deal record.
- Finance Ops (cc'd externally for visibility): we will send a finalized list of Commit changes after the sprint; please prepare to accept the CSV ingestion for forecast adjustments.

I attached the redline for ORN-3421. I'll stand by for counter-signed docs.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Pricing & GTM Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Urgent: Quarter-end discount governance sprint — action required

Alice / Orion Finance —

Looping you in with an update from our internal discount governance sprint. High level: we've cleaned/triaged the immediate set of Q2 deals with elevated discounts. Karthik has conditionally approved ORN-3421 (20%) pending a signed amendment; we've asked the AE to upload the counter-signed redline into our shared Drive. ORN-3578 will be re-priced to 15% (Best Case) unless we see a signed exception by Monday. ORN-3665 remains Commit, but flagged for revenue recognition clarity.

Attached for your ingestion: discount_holdlist_q2.csv (source of truth we updated) and the conditional redline (orion_pricing_redline.pdf). Expect a final CSV from Sales Ops first thing Monday for forecast ingestion.

If Finance needs any additional documentation to accept the commit changes, let me know today and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Marcus
Director, Revenue Operations
